# axm docs list

List installed docs packages

## When to use

List installed docs packages

## Usage

```bash
axm docs list [flags]
```

## Arguments

None.

## Flags

| Name      | Type   | Required | Description                                                                                    |
| --------- | ------ | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--scope` | choice | No       | List docs packages from project (default) or user-level configuration (choices: project, user) |

Global flags are documented on [Global flags](../global-flags).

## Examples

**List installed docs packages**
